subject: Egress addendum & Sentry rate-limit mitigation (AcmeCorp) - action required
messages:
From: AcmeCorp Platform <infra@acmecorp.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden egress spike + Sentry drops — need pricing cap and mitigation

Hi Olga,

Heads up — we saw a ~3x increase in Datadog egress charges after turning on our long-term S3 export and longer retention on logs. At the same time, Sentry is showing a high number of rate-limited events which is affecting error analytics.

Can Redwood help with two things urgently:
- A temporary egress cap/annex we can sign so we don't get a surprise invoice while we investigate (we can follow up with a true-up).
- Short-term Sentry ingestion/workaround to avoid loss of critical events while we tune sampling.

Attached is a CSV with the last 72 hours of egress (acmecorp_egress_spike.csv). We're happy to join a call — this is causing a major incident on the product analytics side.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Platform Ops
AcmeCorp

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: AcmeCorp Platform <infra@acmecorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden egress spike + Sentry drops — need pricing cap and mitigation

Samir — thanks for the data and the heads up.

Short answer: yes, we can help. Proposed immediate path:
1) I will escalate to sales/legal for a fast egress addendum (covers interim cap + true-up).
2) Loop in Sentry to propose an ingestion buffer and temporary SDK sampling tweak so you don't lose critical events.
3) Schedule a 30-min call today for triage and next steps.

Ben/Marissa — can you prioritize a short annex draft (I attached the CSV and included notes below)? If we can get Datadog to agree to a 30-day cap and a defined true-up window it should unblock AcmeCorp.

Samir — are you available 3:00pm PT today for a quick triage call?

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Lead, Cloud Platform
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden egress spike + Sentry drops — need pricing cap and mitigation

Following up with a quick commercial note and an annex draft attached (rdw_datadog_egress_annex_v1.pdf). Options we can offer to AcmeCorp:
- Option A (recommended): 30-day egress cap at current monthly baseline + 20% buffer, with a true-up invoice covering overage at negotiated tiered rates.
- Option B: 60-day amortized credit to smooth the overage (requires finance approval).

I also propose a one-time goodwill credit (equivalent to ~10% of the month-over-month delta) if they sign the annex within 48 hours. Marissa, please flag any legal/finance concerns — I built the annex to be narrowly scoped and reversible.

If Datadog needs to sign off on the cap language, I can forward to our Datadog contact — would like to avoid any SLA exceptions unless absolutely necessary.

Attachments: rdw_datadog_egress_annex_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sentry Support <support@sentry.io>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: infra@acmecorp.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden egress spike + Sentry drops — need pricing cap and mitigation

Hi Olga / Samir,

Thanks for the details — we see the bursts on the ingestion side and can offer two immediate mitigations:
1) Temporary ingestion buffering (up to 48 hours) for high-priority projects while you tune sampling. This requires a short config change and we can enable it for the account.
2) A small SDK sampling patch (attached: sentry_sdk_sampling_patch.diff) that will prioritize error events and reduce noise.

We can enable buffering within 2 hours of a signed request from AcmeCorp. If you want us to proceed we need a short authorization email from Samir confirming which projects are prioritized.

Best,
Maya Kline
Technical Account Manager
Sentry Inc.

From: Datadog Sales <sales@datadog.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Egress addendum request for AcmeCorp — approvals and next steps

Hi Ben / Olga — thanks for the ping and the annex. We reviewed the attached usage CSV and the proposed annex. We can commit to the requested 30-day cap with the following terms:
- Cap equals baseline + 25% buffer for the 30-day window.
- True-up will be billed at the negotiated tier rates (see table in attached Datadog_Addendum_terms.pdf).
- We can provide a one-time invoice credit of 8% on the incremental overage when the annex is signed within 72 hours.

Next steps:
1) We require a signed addendum from AcmeCorp and a short PO referencing Datadog_Addendum_terms.pdf.
2) Once Datadog receives the PO + signed addendum, they will apply the cap within 24 hours.

We can also coordinate a three-way call with AcmeCorp and Sentry to validate the short-term mitigation. Proposed times: tomorrow 10am PT or 3pm PT.

Regards,
Daniel Ruiz
Commercial Lead — Strategic Accounts
Datadog

Attachments referenced: Datadog_Addendum_terms.pdf (link in body)
